facts.label: Was e were em perguntas
facts.sub: Pergunte Where were you? Was it yours? Responda I was at the library, It wasn’t mine e They were at the movies. Com you, we e they, use were.

facts.label: Onde você estava?
facts.sub: Use Where were you? para perguntar sobre ontem. Responda com I was at + lugar. Com mais pessoas, use we were e they were. A pergunta é amistosa quando acompanhada de um sorriso.

facts.label: Was e were
facts.sub: Use was com I, he, she e it. Use were com you, we e they. Nas negativas, use wasn’t e weren’t. Veja: She wasn’t at home. They weren’t at school.

items.s: Was goes with I, he, she and it.
Were you…? is a past question.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: Was goes with I, he, she and it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Were goes with I. → Falso (I uses was.)
Were you…? is a past question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A quiet street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool morning on a quiet street in Portland. Eva walks to the bus stop with a coffee. Her neighbor Kai waves from his steps. A brown bag sits next to his door. He looks worried and a little confused. He asks where she was last night.
“Hi, Eva. Where were you last night?” says Kai. “I was at the library until nine. Why?” says Eva. “Someone left a bag on my steps. Was it yours?” says Kai.
